'''Pritarr''' were [[Feline/Legends|feline]] creatures [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

==Characteristics==
Pritarr communicated over long distances using low-frequency sounds, such as an infrasonic "purr", in their search for prey. Their sensitivity to these sounds allowed them to detect seismic activity long before it happened, which the [[Untamed]] used to their advantage by preparing for disaster if their pritarr were restless.<ref name="Codex" />

During the [[Third Galactic War]], a trained pritarr cub mount, known as the Emperor's Pritarr Cub, could be won by attendees to the [[Star Cluster Casino|Star Cluster]] and [[Club Vertica Casino]]s on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shadaa]].<ref name="TOR:NSN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=event|Nar Shaddaa Nightlife}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pritarr appear in the [[2019]]'s sixth expansion to the videogame ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', called [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']].
